questionLatex: In $C_4$ plants (such as maize and sugarcane), the initial fixation of atmospheric $\text{CO}_2$ takes place in the mesophyll cells and is catalyzed by the enzyme:
solutionLatex: In $C_4$ plants, PEP carboxylase fixes $\text{CO}_2$ with Phosphoenolpyruvate (PEP) in mesophyll cells to form oxaloacetate ($4C$). RuBisCO operates later in bundle sheath cells.

questionLatex: In a standard normal human Electrocardiogram (ECG), the depolarization of the ventricles is represented by the:
solutionLatex: The P wave represents atrial depolarization. The QRS complex represents ventricular depolarization (leading to ventricular contraction). The T wave represents ventricular repolarization.

questionLatex: During molecular cloning, restriction endonucleases make staggered cuts in the double-stranded DNA leaving single-stranded overhanging sequences known as:
solutionLatex: Enzymes like EcoRI cut palindromic recognition sequences staggered away from the center of symmetry, creating single-stranded sticky ends that readily form hydrogen bonds with complementary fragments.
